Batch 2 (exploratory): four experiment families on resting TDBRAIN EEG

Bottom line: 0 of 7 challengers met the pre-set triage rule (mean remission AUC ≥ 0.60, gain over E01 ≥ 0.05, positive gain in every repeat). The highest mean remission AUC was E13-add at 0.517. No method clearly beats chance or E01; none needed (or earned) the batch-aware permutation. This batch is exploratory (chosen after seeing the baseline), uses the same 164 patients, and is conditional on session 1 being pretreatment. The oddball experiments E02–E05 remain blocked and untested.

Audit corrections to the baseline report are in AUDIT.md and the updated REPORT.html (earlier caption claimed all E01-minus-E01-PSD intervals crossed zero; remission seed-44 did not, because E01-PSD itself scored below chance there).

Challenger metrics for every repeat (PPV, sensitivity, nPPV, Brier, balanced accuracy, TP/FP/TN/FN): plotted_data/all_metrics.csv. E01_ref is E01 re-implemented in the batch-2 framework; predictions are identical to the baseline (max probability difference 0).

What each test taught us

  • E10 (nonlinear): boosting on the same 65 features did not help (AUC below E01 in most repeats): no usable interaction signal at this sample size.
  • E11 (periodic/aperiodic): parameter fits are good (see figure) but neither alone nor added to E01 does it predict remission.
  • E12 (covariance tangent space): adds spatial detail and ~10x runtime without any gain.
  • E13 (EC/EO reactivity): relative covariance summaries are not better than the compact power-contrast control (see B2 right), and are invariant to gain by construction. Reliability is very high (median r 0.99) but confounded with cleaning rank loss (B6), so it is not evidence of a physiological signal.

Limitations

  • Exploratory, post-baseline; the same 164 people were reused (new splits are not untouched validation); bootstrap intervals are conditional on saved predictions and uncorrected for 7 methods.
  • Session-1 timing assumed. ICA used up to 3 components (cap rule arbitrary), 17 non-converged fits (AUDIT.md). Interpolated channels retained in covariance space; covariances are rank-reduced by ICA/interpolation, so the extreme eigenvalue summaries may reflect shrinkage floors.
  • E13 spread features track ICA/interpolation burden (see B6 caption), so the covariance-reactivity measure is partly a processing artifact.
  • Covariance features exist for 141 of 164 patients (others imputed/mapped to the reference); connectivity for 155; E11 fits rejected in 9% of cases.
  • Prior-art comparisons used abstract-level reading only; two spec links did not resolve to the described studies (BATCH2_PROTOCOL.md).

Decision

Stop this batch: no challenger qualified. Do not add variants or ensembles. Resting-only conventional and covariance features appear exhausted for this cohort; the open lever remains obtaining pretreatment oddball (or larger labeled resting) data.
